environment: lab: F6 archive database copy (synthetic OTel Demo lab data), not production

conclusions.author: model
conclusions.body: Target checkout-lab (incident 0834af7e-0951-5850-a409-b1550255ee0a) showed an elevated checkout error ratio across the degraded recovery windows: error_ratio was 0.8181818181818182 in the window ending 2026-10-08T18:34:25.071453-07:00, 1.0 in the window ending 2026-10-08T18:35:25.303346-07:00, 0.875 in the window ending 2026-10-08T18:36:25.557284-07:00 and 0.6666666666666666 in the window ending 2026-10-08T18:37:25.750901-07:00 — i.e. most to all observed requests in those one-minute windows failed. This was an error-rate degradation, not a latency or capacity event: latency p95 stayed between 48.0 and 72.49999999999997 ms and deployment available/ready replicas stayed at 1.0 (min_in_window 1.0) throughout. Each window carries sample_count 5 and request_rate_per_second between 0.008333333333333333 and 0.04583333333333333, so absolute affected request volume was small and each ratio rests on few samples. Health returned from the window ending 2026-10-08T18:38:25.903664-07:00, where error_ratio was 0.0, and stayed at 0.0 through the final window ending 2026-10-08T18:48:27.867197-07:00. Recovery was confirmed at 2026-10-08T18:48:27.867197 after a sustained_window_seconds of 600, and observation ended at 2026-10-08T18:48:27.975626 (ended_reason recovery_confirmed). Observed degradation thus spanned roughly 8 minutes, from the window starting 2026-10-08T18:29:25.071453-07:00 to the window ending 2026-10-08T18:37:25.750901-07:00; the incident itself ran from creation at 2026-10-08T18:30:06.388345-07:00 until that resolution.

conclusions.author: model
conclusions.body: 1) Alert on checkout error_ratio together with request volume, so that low-traffic windows (request_rate_per_second of 0.008333333333333333 to 0.04583333333333333 with sample_count 5) are not read as broad outages; require a minimum request count before paging. 2) Record service-level and dependency-level error ratios side by side during recovery sampling, because here the service error_ratio reached 1.0 while dependency_error_ratio stayed between 0.08333333333333333 and 0.13793103448275862, which is the discrimination a responder needs first. 3) Keep replica signals (deployment_available_replicas, deployment_available_replicas_min_in_window, deployment_ready_replicas) in the health profile, since all stayed at 1.0 and quickly rule out capacity or rollout causes. 4) Capture an investigation report or event/log evidence during the degraded windows; without it the causal chain for this incident remains open even though recovery was confirmed.

conclusions.author: model
conclusions.body: The checkout-lab target served mostly-failing requests for four consecutive one-minute windows: error_ratio 0.8181818181818182 (window ending 2026-10-08T18:34:25.071453-07:00), 1.0 (ending 2026-10-08T18:35:25.303346-07:00), 0.875 (ending 2026-10-08T18:36:25.557284-07:00) and 0.6666666666666666 (ending 2026-10-08T18:37:25.750901-07:00).

conclusions.author: model
conclusions.body: Deployment capacity signals did not degrade during the error-rate windows: deployment_available_replicas, deployment_available_replicas_min_in_window and deployment_ready_replicas were all 1.0 for the windows ending 2026-10-08T18:34:25.071453-07:00 through 2026-10-08T18:37:25.750901-07:00, so the elevated errors are not explained by missing or unready replicas.

conclusions.author: model
conclusions.body: Health was confirmed and sustained: error_ratio was 0.0 from the window ending 2026-10-08T18:38:25.903664-07:00 onward, the healthy_since timestamp is 2026-10-08T18:38:25.903664-07:00, and the recovery transition recovery_confirmed occurred at 2026-10-08T18:48:27.867197 after sustained_window_seconds of 600, with observation ending at 2026-10-08T18:48:27.975626.

conclusions.author: model
conclusions.body: Evidence against treating a failing downstream dependency as the whole explanation: during the degraded windows the dependency_error_ratio was only 0.09782608695652174, 0.13793103448275862, 0.11864406779661017 and 0.08333333333333333, far below the service error_ratio of 0.8181818181818182 to 1.0, while dependency_deployments_available stayed at 8.0. A dependency outage at the observed rate does not by itself account for near-total checkout request failures.

conclusions.author: model
conclusions.body: The trigger for the elevated checkout error_ratio is not established by the available telemetry: investigation_report is null and the recorded human action is only control:register_remediation by demo at 2026-10-08T18:33:23.358882-07:00, so the recovery coincidence with that action cannot be separated from spontaneous recovery, and no error, log or configuration-change evidence covering 2026-10-08T18:29:25.071453-07:00 to 2026-10-08T18:37:25.750901-07:00 is present in this dataset.
